title: Statistics
summary: Sampling, data displays and their shape, two-way tables, summary statistics, box plots and outliers, standard deviation, percentiles, time series and scatter plots.

cards.title: Collecting representative data
cards.rule: A sample should represent the whole population. Random samples avoid bias.

cards.title: Data displays
cards.rule: Histograms for numerical data, column graphs for categories.
lines: Shape: symmetric, positively skewed (tail to the right), negatively skewed, bimodal

cards.title: Two-way tables
cards.rule: Count by two categories, then use the row and column totals.
lines: 25 of 40 students play sport; 15 of those are in Year 10
\(\tfrac{15}{25} = 60\%\) of the sport players are in Year 10

cards.title: Summary statistics
cards.rule: Centre: mean and median. Spread: range and IQR.
cards.note: An outlier pulls the mean, not the median.

cards.title: Box plots and outliers
lines: \(Q_1 = 10,\ Q_3 = 18\): IQR 8, upper fence \(18 + 12 = 30\), so 34 is an outlier

fig.alt: Box plot: min 4, Q1 10, median 14, Q3 18, max 26

cards.title: Standard deviation
cards.rule: Standard deviation \(\sigma\) measures spread around the mean. Small \(\sigma\): data close to the mean.

cards.title: Cumulative frequency and percentiles
cards.rule: Cumulative frequency is a running total. Read percentiles off the graph (ogive).
lines: 40 values: the median is halfway between the 20th and 21st

cards.title: Time-series data
cards.rule: Data collected over time, with time on the x-axis.
lines: Look for the trend (up or down) and any seasonal pattern

cards.title: Bivariate data and scatter plots
cards.rule: Two numerical variables: explanatory on the x-axis, response on the y-axis.
lines: Describe the direction (positive or negative), strength and form (linear or not)
cards.tip: correlation doesn't prove that one causes the other.

cards.title: Line of best fit
cards.rule: Draw it by eye with about the same number of points on each side.
lines: Predicting inside the data (interpolation) is more reliable than outside it
